versions.content: Semantics of attribute DiagnosticFunctionInhibit- Source . eventGroup If the reference DiagnosticFunctionInhibitSource . eventGroup exists this means that the inhibition effectively applies for a group of DiagnosticEvent s where the actual grouping is defined in the scope of the Fim.
